title: Recognize apps without disturbing the shelf
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Identify app folders without interrupting browsing.

**Expected behaviour** · Read direct app.json descriptors for visible candidates with bounded concurrency and prioritize the activated item. Preserve focus and order on late results.

**Scope boundary** · A valid nonblank name and optional text brief identify the v0.2 app. Missing or malformed metadata leaves the folder browsable.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-031

**Depends on** · WI-027, WI-029, WI-030

**Verify** · Measure request counts in a representative large home. Activate a pending card, change routes and deliver a late response.

**Effort basis** · Asynchronous discovery and cancellation.
